ip-addr.text: Show the computer's IP addresses with `ip`.

text.debian: Install the package `dnsutils` and look up the IP address of `example.com` with `dig`.
text.arch: Install the package `bind` and look up the IP address of `example.com` with `dig`.
text.redhat: Install the package `bind-utils` and look up the IP address of `example.com` with `dig`.

hint.debian: `sudo apt update`, `sudo apt install dnsutils` and then `dig +short example.com`.
hint.redhat: `sudo dnf install bind-utils` and then `dig +short example.com`.

ss.text: Find out which ports are listening on the computer with `ss`.

curl-localhost.text: Fetch the start page of the practice server on your own computer, `http://localhost:8080`, with `curl`.

hint.debian: On Debian/Ubuntu curl must be installed: `sudo apt install curl`. If you get *Couldn't connect to server*, minserver is stopped – start it with `minserver`.
hint.arch: `curl http://localhost:8080`. If you get *Couldn't connect to server*, minserver is stopped – start it with `minserver`.
hint.redhat: `curl http://localhost:8080`. If you get *Couldn't connect to server*, minserver is stopped – start it with `minserver`.

spara.text: Save the web page `https://example.com` as the file `~/exempel.html`.
spara.hint: Stand in your home directory and use `curl -o exempel.html https://example.com` or `wget -O exempel.html https://example.com`.

hosts.text: The server `192.168.1.10` should be called `server.lan`, but the name is not in DNS. Add it to `/etc/hosts` and then ping `server.lan`.
hosts.hint: The file is owned by root: `echo '192.168.1.10 server.lan' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts` and then `ping -c 3 server.lan`.

ssh.text: Run the command `hostname` on the server `server.lan` with `ssh` as the user `elev`.

hint.debian: `ssh elev@server.lan hostname` – and answer `yes` to the question about the host key.
hint.arch: First install the ssh client: `sudo pacman -S openssh`. Then `ssh elev@server.lan hostname` – and answer `yes` to the question about the host key.
hint.redhat: `ssh elev@server.lan hostname` – and answer `yes` to the question about the host key.
